note: Purpose-scoped context clauses with an explicit kind. 'eliciting' clauses invite a reply (only used when the message genuinely asks for one); 'neutral' clauses never do and are used for needs_reply=false / resolved / automated messages. Clauses are inserted as their own capitalized sentence with single terminal punctuation and assert no unbacked copy/CC/team/workstream/prior-exchange fact. Public and each private split draw from disjoint pools (AR-1).
